stage_2_story.text_en:
David loved spending time in his garden. Every spring, he would prepare the garden beds with fresh soil and plan which flowers to plant that year.

One Saturday morning, David went to the plant shop and bought tulip bulbs, a small rose bush, and a packet of sunflower seeds. He also picked up a young lily plant because his wife, Sarah, always loved the sweet smell of lilies.

Back at home, David started working in the garden. First, he dug a new garden bed along the stone path. He placed the tulip bulbs carefully in the soil and covered them gently. Then he planted the rose bush in a sunny corner near the fence. He made sure the roots were deep enough in the ground so the bush would grow strong.

Next, David planted the sunflower seeds along the back wall. He knew that in a few months, their tall stems would reach high above the fence. Finally, he placed the lily plant near the kitchen window, where Sarah could see it every morning.

Weeks passed, and one by one the flowers began to bloom. The tulips opened their colorful petals first, followed by the rose bush, which was covered in soft pink flowers. The sunflowers grew tall and golden, and the lily filled the air with its lovely smell.

On a warm Friday afternoon, David cut some of the best flowers and made a beautiful bouquet for Sarah. When she came home, she saw the garden and the bouquet on the table. Her eyes filled with happy tears. "This is the most beautiful surprise," she said, giving David a big hug.
